shortDescription: Aya Gold & Silver NASDAQ:AYA said Wednesday its Q3 consolidated production jumped 51% Y/Y and 21% Q/Q to 2.03M silver equivalent oz, but shares fell 4% alongside sharp declines in most precious metals miners.The company said its Zgounder mine in Morocco produced 1.49M oz of silver in Q3, up 11% Y/Y…

children: said Wednesday its Q3 consolidated production
and 21% Q/Q to 2.03M silver equivalent oz, but shares fell 4% alongside sharp declines in most precious metals miners.

The company said its Zgounder mine in Morocco produced 1.49M oz of silver in Q3, up 11% Y/Y, and the mill processed 376,863 tonnes of ore at 4,096 metric tons/day, up 23% Y/Y, with silver recovery averaging 92% for the quarter.

Boumadine operation, which began reclaiming and selling historical pyrite stockpiles late last year and is also in Morocco, produced 536,879 silver equivalent oz, up 186% from Q2, including 244,875 oz of silver and 4,300 oz of gold.
The company is "firmly on track" to achieve its full-year production guidance, President and CEO Benoit La Salle said; in March, Aya
forecast output would reach 6.2M-6.8M silver equivalent oz, including 5.2M-5.8M oz of silver at Zgounder.

title: Aya Gold & Silver Q3 production surged 51% Y/Y; Morocco mine hits quarterly record
